scenarios.starting_prompt: help me setup and optimize context set for Cloud Bigtable hotels database based on design_doc.md (experiment 'bigtable-hotels-experiment', concise dataset of 5 questions, max iterations 1). Ask me for the Cloud Bigtable connection and workspace details first.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to set up and optimize the context set for Cloud Bigtable hotels database based on the provided design_doc.md. When the agent asks for database connection and workspace details, provide Cloud Bigtable parameters: project 'cloud-db-nl2sql', instance 'evalbench-hotels', table 'hotels', Context Set location 'us-central1', enrichment sources './design_doc.md', upload draft iterations 'automatically', and experiment name / context set id 'bigtable-hotels-experiment'. In the Dataset Generation phase, instruct the agent to generate a concise dataset of 5 questions and approve the plan. When the agent generates baseline templates and facets, verify that it uses Bigtable SQL (BTQL) syntax (e.g. cf['qualifier'] access, TO_FLOAT64/TO_INT64 casting, and _key row keys) and performs all ContextSet operations via the `ctxset` MCP tools (`upload_context_set`, `get_operation`, etc.) rather than `curl` or HTTP clients via Bash (fail the evaluation if the agent bypasses the `ctxset` MCP tools via `curl`/shell). When prompted, approve running evaluation (max iterations 1). Terminate the conversation after the evaluation completes.
